card.emailRequired: Email MFA is kept as the mandatory fallback method so an account can't be permanently locked out.
card.configured: Shown next to an MFA method to say it's been set up and usable — not that it's the active/preferred one.
card.required: Indicates this specific MFA method is mandated by admin policy, not that MFA overall is required.

notifications.agentOffline: Toggle for whether you're notified when one of your agents goes offline.

preferences.languageHelper: Clarifies that this language choice is stored per-browser, and won't follow the user to another device.

columns.definition: Shows the charset's defined characters, or file info (size/byte count) for an uploaded binary charset.

typeLabels.file: Indicates this charset was uploaded as a binary .hcchr file rather than typed in.
typeLabels.hex: Indicates this charset's definition is stored as hex byte pairs rather than literal characters.
